ننهوي (form VII)
# نَنْهَوِي (nanhawī) /nan.ha.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَوَى (inhawā)
# نَنْهَوِيَ (nanhawiya) /nan.ha.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَوَى (inhawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
